The '''Horticultural Society''' of Alderath consisted of botanists and horticulturalists devoted to the study of their world's flora. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] the society sought out and obtained a specimen of the [[Millennium blossom]]; though it was stolen by a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] before reaching Alderath.
